name: marin
description_en: Open-source framework for the research and development of foundation models.
readme_excerpt: Marin > "I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship." > – Louisa May Alcott Marin is a research program, software platform, and community for the research and development of foundation models. Marin's concern is training large language models. This includes data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation.
